verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gusto publishes API reference pages, indexed in llms.txt, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Nothing in the pack documents an interactive reference with runnable or try-it examples. A machine-readable spec is only a building block, and a static reference list is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
